column1: # What enforces each requirement in this library's specs (0024-spec-format FR-011 - FR-014).
# mechanism: check | gate | review | none. by: "<repo>: <command>" for check and gate, the defining requirement for review, "-" for none.

column4: note
suite/governance-neutral.test.ts: the code of governance names no engine and no part of a relational schema; its imports are held by FR-004 (engine and kernel only)
Planned: the logical schema is built after governance; its imports are held by FR-004 already
Planned: the physical schema is built after the logical one; its imports are held by FR-004 already
suite/layers.test.ts: each unit may import only the units of the table, and an import that climbs or reaches around is layers/above or layers/around, by package name and by path
suite/layers.test.ts: layers 1 to 3 and the engine import only the kernel and the library, and a driver or node:fs is layers/external
Planned: the identities of governance are built (0003-governance FR-005); the links from the logical and the physical schema come with them
Planned: the flow report is built with the logical schema
suite/layers.test.ts: every file of the real tree is in a unit, and one in no unit is layers/unclassified
suite/layers.test.ts: the four layer entries of exports are the api.ts of their folders, and an import of a subpath exports does not name is layers/private
suite/layers.test.ts: a relative import into another unit is layers/relative, and one inside the unit is not
suite/layers.test.ts: the check finds nothing in the real tree, each rule is found in a copy, and verify runs tools/check.ts
suite/layers.test.ts: the engine imports nothing of the library, and only the kernel by package name
suite/engine.test.ts: a point carries its name and is frozen, and a name with no namespace does not compile
suite/engine-manifest.test.ts: an identifier is checked, a manifest is frozen data with the engine's contract and empty lists by default, and a lazy entry holds what is known before it loads
suite/engine-manifest.test.ts: a contribution is typed by its point, and a value of another type does not compile (@ts-expect-error, checked by the compiler in verify)
suite/engine-compose.test.ts: an extension defined in an imported module is in no composition until the project lists it, and a second composition shares nothing with the first

suite/engine-compose.test.ts: the order satisfies requires and keeps the project's order, and a duplicate, a missing extension, a cycle, a contract the engine lacks and a handle not provided come back together as values
suite/engine-compose.test.ts: the contributions of a point come back typed and in the order of the composition

suite/engine-activation.test.ts: start activates in order once, a lazy extension loads and activates once on its event (two at once too) after what it requires, and a bad load, a failed load and a throwing activate are values that stay
suite/engine-activation.test.ts: use gives only a declared and provided handle, typed by it; undeclared and unprovided are error values, for a lazy extension too
suite/governance-model.test.ts: the constructors are total and the pieces are frozen data with their defaults; a domain is the domain when nothing is wrong
suite/governance-model.test.ts: every case of the datatype union is described, and none names a database
suite/governance-model.test.ts: the names of a concept are literal types, and an identifying attribute or relationship it lacks does not compile (@ts-expect-error, checked in verify)

suite/governance-model.test.ts: a bad name (not lower camel case), a duplicate, an annotation out of place, an unresolved relationship or code list, and a bad identifier (none, optional, a relationship that is not one, unknown) come back together as values; a relationship given as a function allows a cycle
suite/governance-elements.test.ts: an identity is made of names, and every element is listed in a fixed order with its kind, name, definition and parent
suite/governance-elements.test.ts: the trace graph has the elements as nodes and contains, identifies (an attribute or a relationship) and references as edges, each joining two nodes
suite/governance-annotations.test.ts: an annotation is typed by its kind, says where it may be, and is read back typed (@ts-expect-error, checked in verify)
suite/governance-annotations.test.ts: an extension contributes a vocabulary through the engine and the composition gives them in order
suite/governance-annotations.test.ts: lint returns data, the core rules first (a missing definition, an unknown kind) and then each vocabulary's in order
suite/governance-vocabularies.test.ts: the documentation kinds go where they say and the vocabulary has no rule
suite/governance-vocabularies.test.ts: a citation is NNNN-slug FR-nnn, requirementsOf says who cites what, and the uncited and malformed rules fire and stay quiet
suite/governance-vocabularies.test.ts: personal data names a DPV-PD term (a term that is not one does not compile), dpvClassOf and dpvIri, and the category and purpose rules

suite/governance-dpv.test.ts: a CSV that is not the pinned one is refused and the generated file carries the pinned source and digest; the live --check against the CSV runs in .github/workflows/data.yml
suite/governance-vocabularies.test.ts: the security kinds go where they say, and the scope, restricted-access and personal-unprotected rules fire and stay quiet
suite/governance-vocabularies.test.ts: owner and steward go on a domain, a concept or a code list, and the owner-missing rule fires and stays quiet

suite/governance-vocabularies.test.ts: the quality kinds (pattern, range, retention, deprecated, default, unique, differs, audited, openness) go where they say, and each rule fires and stays quiet, a default being held to its datatype
suite/governance-vocabularies.test.ts: a lookup goes on a concept and says its members, and one that names a member the concept lacks is found
suite/arca.test.ts: the party model is a valid domain named arca_party given as a result; its imports (governance only) are held by 0001-layers FR-004

suite/arca.test.ts: the concepts, code lists, attributes and relationships are those of the model it replaces, and every old table and column is accounted for by the domain and the conventions a layer below must follow
suite/arca.test.ts: a person and an organization are identified by their relationship of cardinality one to a party, every other concept by an attribute named for it
suite/arca.test.ts: every element has a definition and lint with every vocabulary of the library finds nothing
suite/arca.test.ts: each personal attribute names an existing DPV-PD category and a purpose, and every concept that holds personal data is confidential
suite/arca.test.ts: the four reference code lists carry the codes, labels and definitions of the old reference data and are open; the two closed lists carry theirs
suite/arca.test.ts: the domain is audited with removal by marking, and has an owner
suite/arca.test.ts: one identifier of a kind, parties_differ, the default of is_primary and each lookup are said as governance
suite/arca.test.ts: every concept cites requirements and every citation names a requirement that exists in this library's specifications
suite/naming.test.ts: a name is lower camel case, and domain returns a name with an underscore or a capital first as an error, for every kind of element
suite/naming.test.ts: words splits at lower to upper, around digits and at the end of a run of capitals; for 500 generated names the words are at least one, stable, and join back to the name
Planned: built with the logical schema, whose conventions for the words of each element are specified with it
Planned: built with the physical schema, whose case styles, quoting and limits are specified with it
Planned: built with the physical schema, where a case style is an extension that snake case is the default of
Planned: built with the physical schema, which writes the stored value of a code by the case style
Planned: built with the logical schema, whose projection returns two elements that name alike
Planned: governance's names and words are built (0005-naming FR-001, FR-002); the logical and physical conventions come with those layers
suite/arca.test.ts: every name is lower camel case, and the words of the domain's names make the old model's tables and columns in snake case
